capabilities: Create cards with a cover image, title and description
Group cards into decks and a deck pad
Edit a card's note in Obsidian's own editor
Print a deck as PDF or order printed cards
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition study tool; it organizes idea cards with cover images for visual recall.
extras: Free and offline; needs Obsidian 1.13.2 or newer. Optional image search and card printing use your own API keys, kept in Obsidian's secret storage. A daily check reads a GitHub file for new versions and can be turned off.
problem: Text-only notes and mental models are slow to scan and recall when they sit in a long list of files.

relations.evidence: Image search, once you've added a free Pixabay API key
order real cards from The Game Crafter
install BRAT, choose "Add beta plugin" and enter visualrecall/tracecards

summary: Visual card organizer that keeps idea notes as Markdown files with cover images, grouped into decks.
